purpose: Relay I/O for task bootstrap fetch — new export fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap that queries relay for kind-30078 task state sync events, decrypts them, applies CRDT LWW/FWW merge gate, and returns synthetic TaskEvents for persistence

public_api.name: fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap
public_api.signature: async function fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap(groupId: string, ownPubkey: string, signer: EventSigner, client: MarmotClient | null, relays: string[], currentState: TaskState): Promise<TaskEvent[]>
public_api.description: Fetches kind-30078 task state sync events from relay, decrypts NIP-44 payloads, applies CRDT LWW/FWW merge gate against currentState, and returns synthetic task.created TaskEvents for winning tasks. Non-fatal: returns [] on any error.

test_targets: Task not in store → returns task.created event (FWW)
Task in store, payload.updatedAt > existing → returns task.created (LWW win)
Task in store, payload.updatedAt < existing → skips (LWW loss)
Task in store, equal updatedAt, lower updatedBy wins → returns task.created
Task in store, equal updatedAt, higher updatedBy → skips (tie-breaker loss)
Two payloads from different inviters commute (AC-8)
Idempotent: events.length > 0 guard prevents second bootstrap call (AC-5)
